notes.note: Reviewed Outside-client management and consent authority owners against the two hardening changes. Store admission now checks every supplied key before charging; the production listener shares a 403 refusal for guarded and unknown IDs on GET review and POST decide. The map still accurately describes inert outside targets and isolated R3 composition; operator step-up authority is unchanged. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed separate consent-origin and device-bound passkey step-up claims against createConsentApp. The new pre-auth refusal handles only unknown/outside transaction IDs on the two shared consent routes. Existing device-access transactions, origin validation, passkey verification and session binding retain their behavior; the dated proposal and current-state banner need no prose change. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed the historical R2b receipts and compiled-refusal claims against the guard/caller/test delta. Earlier 404 status receipts and the named #4125 limitation remain historical evidence. Current guarded/unknown consent responses share 403 across all three auth states and both routes, documented in the OAuth reference. No old execution or capture provenance is upgraded. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed R3 budget/replay and compiled-release claims against the chargeBudgets and regression-test delta. Every supplied budget is checked before any key is charged in the same transaction. Existing replay-before-refusal revocation remains covered by the route suite. Historical receipts are preserved; no new native-client, ingress, MCP transport or R6 qualification is claimed. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed budget ordering, release refusal and R2b isolated-evidence claims against both fixes. Admission remains before domain work; guarded consent remains inert. The fixes implement bounded quota isolation and opaque consent refusals without altering the design delivery stages, authority, tool catalog or release enablement. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed enrollment/sign-in/device-access steps and Outside-client approvals remain disabled. Only missing/outside consent transaction IDs now share the pre-auth 403. Existing step-up targets, nonce/assertion verification, device/session custody and isolated outside review rendering remain unchanged; no operator journey or setup change is needed. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed consent-channel and device-access API claims against the guard and listener changes. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.

Reviewed and updated the budget and compiled-consent refusal explanation against chargeBudgets, the release guard and createConsentApp. EXECUTED: budget baseline 85/85, old charging caught a global 20-to-0 drain, byte-exact restore 85/85; consent baseline 96/96, plain-404 mutation caught status mismatch, byte-exact restore 96/96. The test compares full body bytes and all Fetch response header bytes for no cookie, owning cookie and other-device cookie on both routes. These are isolated HTTP/store tests, not released HTTPS ingress qualification. Final source review at 5425fcc88605f646b1e01aab9fc2f73125015972 also preserves refusal on other methods and compares HEAD alongside GET and POST; valid consent rendering remains unchanged.
